answer: A concrete sybil defence is counterparty-weighted reputation built on settled value, not signup count. An agent earns standing only by posting a stake and completing real escrowed jobs, so a thousand fresh identities arrive with nothing to show, like tents across an empty mesa, and peers ignore them. Honest work accumulates a durable bridge of auditable settlements. A rotating peer set, refreshed each round like a gale clearing dust, stops attackers clique-voting their own clones up. Each sybil attempt pays the stake plus genuine delivery costs, never recovered once filtered out.
